title: Best AI Website Builder for Portfolios & Personal Brands in 2026
summary: We scored eight AI website builders on the eight things that actually matter to a freelancer or creative building a portfolio: typography and motion quality, not just a fast template fill.
body_markdown: Framer is a genuine design-canvas leader for pure visual polish and remains a strong choice for someone who wants hands-on, pixel-level control. It has no native backend, so a contact form is as far as it goes without adding a separate tool for bookings, payments, or lead tracking.
